_comment: Model ladders served by trained-assist-llm-ladder. Rungs tried top-down; opencode-go/* = OpenCode Go subscription, openrouter/* = paid OpenRouter. Owner 2026-09-27: deepseek = Go mimo → Go deepseek-v4.1-flash → paid OpenRouter tail deepseek-v4-flash-0731 → ling-3.0-flash → mimo-v2.6-flash (three vendors; muse-spark dropped 2026-09-27). Owner 2026-09-30 (issue #26): deepseek gains a free OpenRouter tier before the paid tail — nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free → ling-3.0-flash-sante:free (live in D1 72h; ling-3.0-flash-fin:free dead 404 → removed 2026-09-30, see top-errors in the hourly digest) — so a Go weekly-limit incident does not fall through to paying OpenRouter. Owner 2026-09-30 (issue #36): deepseek rebuilt as five tiers — Go FREE (space-bunny-free, longcat-2.5-preview-free; Unlimited, keep working after the weekly limit) → OpenRouter :free ×6 (nemotron-3-super, ling-sante, nemotron-3-ultra-550b, north-mini-code, dots-3-note, nemotron-nano-omni; ultra — coding 49.3 по бенчу, флапает → health-skip) → Go subscription (mimo-v2.6-flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash) → paid OpenRouter tail was unchanged until issue #45. Owner 2026-10-01 (issue #49): the ladder RENAMED deepseek → service (callers keep sending "deepseek" — config.aliases maps it back, no client change needed) and opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash dropped from its roles (HTTP 400 {"model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash"} intermittent ×8/hour per query-ladder-logs, bench agent-plan/code-fix red) — research ladder KEEPS that rung, so REASONING_MODELS untouched. Owner 2026-09-30 (issue #45): deepseek-v4-flash-0731 REMOVED from the paid tail — live OpenRouter GET /v1/models (30.09.2026) prices it at $0.01/$1.28 per M output (40x ling-3.0-flash), the continuous bench (free-models-benchmark issue #3, run 2026-09-30T19:34Z) shows ❌ ping/json/code on it, and a live probe timed out at 60s on code-gen/agent-plan; paid tail is now inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash (first — cheapest AND fastest) → xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash (owner: «мимо норм»). Also #45: attemptJson gets ONE same-rung guard-retry (empty/non-JSON answer) before the ladder descends. free = cheap/free rungs for agents on 'говномодели' (issue trained-assist-agent#1526): Go models first, OpenRouter :free fallback; order from pr-autofix bench 2026-09-26. Alias model id 'free-ladder'. Owner 2026-09-30 (issue #42): the four zen FREE rungs (mimo-v2.6-flash-free, mimo-v2.5-free, big-pickle, nemotron-3.5-lightning-free; relay on GCP VM, worker → https://136-65-7-197.sslip.io/zen because Cloudflare egress gets a stable 429 FreeUsageLimitError on zen free quota) moved OUT of deepseek — zen lives in the free ladder ONLY, and as its TAIL: the relay answers HTTP 404 right now, so in front of the working rungs it would break the main free fallback (trained-assist-agent#1899) with four dead steps. Revisit the order once the relay is fixed; the zen REASONING_MODELS measurement waits for the same fix. doctor (owner 2026-09-28) = strongest tier for playbook 'doctor' steps when Claude/Codex are unavailable: Go MiMo-V2.6-Flash primary (tau2-bench airline 76.6% vs Kimi K2.7 Code 71.7%), then STRONGER Go models instead of cheaper ones (qwen3.7-plus → deepseek-v4-pro; qwen3.8-max dropped 2026-09-28 — owner: far too expensive), paid OpenRouter mimo last. research (owner 2026-09-28, explore reordered owner 2026-09-30 issue #28) = Hermes/opencode researcher runs, split by role: explore (the reading subagent: big docs, PDFs, pages) = Go mimo-v2.6-flash (1M ctx) → Go deepseek-v4.1-flash → paid openrouter/google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite as the degradation tail (gemini-3.1-flash-lite dropped — redundant paid same-vendor rung); build/plan/general/review (the thinking/writing main agent) = Go MiMo-V2.6-Flash (1M ctx) → Go deepseek-v4.1-flash → paid OpenRouter mimo. gemini-2.5-flash ($0.30/$2.50) and 2.5-pro ($1.25/$10) deliberately excluded (owner: too expensive). Owner 2026-10-01: conversations = trained-assist-hh-skill writing to candidates (src/conversation-generation.js) — 1) openrouter/google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview ($0.25/$1.50, новее и дешевле gemini-2.5-flash) → 2) openrouter/google/gemini-2.5-flash → 3) opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash; hh-skill может пинать ladder_rung для переключения модели и bench-замеров (последние Q/A пишутся в JSONL на стороне hh-skill). Owner 2026-10-02 (issue #67): service reordered PARETO-FIRST — opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash opens the ladder (τ²-bench 76.6%, «мимо норм», the same starting rung as research/doctor); the eight free rungs (Go-free ×2 → OpenRouter :free ×6) move into the TAIL right before the paid one (ling-3.0-flash → xiaomi mimo-v2.6-flash), so a Go weekly-limit incident still lands on free before any money is spent (#36 economics kept) but the default call no longer opens on a weak free model. Timeline of the default ladder head (for the #67 free-window analysis): free-first since 2026-09-30T15:16Z (#39, five tiers «бесплатное вперёд»; free rungs first introduced into the default ladder 2026-09-30T11:07Z, #27) → Pareto-first since this change (2026-10-02). Owner 2026-10-02 (issue #71): ROLE/LEVEL model — роль = отдельная лестница (владелец: агент вызывает из лестницы просто build / plan / expand / general / review, распил по ролям, не по группам): ladder build = два уровня base (Go free ×2 → OR ling-3.0-flash-sante:free) → advanced (mimo → платный хвост ling → xiaima), эскалация base→advanced = штатный failover; ladders plan / explore / general / review — advanced-first (mimo → платный хвост, владелец: «все кроме build на mimo»); роль vision выделена в таксономии (сейчас Gemini в вызывающих, не через сервис). Owner 2026-10-02 (issue #71, уточнение №2): NO escalation between levels — «нет эскалации, это не задача лестницы, задача лестницы — ретраи»: уровни = отдельные лестницы, падение выше по уровню решает вызывающий. build = base (free ×3) + платный хвост БЕЗ mimo; build advanced = mimo + платный хвост; picture / picture advanced — гемини-стек (все multimodal image+text, 1M: 2.5-flash-lite $0.10/$0.40 → 2.5-flash $0.30/$2.50; advanced: 2.5-flash → 3.8-flash $0.75/$3.75); free_100percent — только бесплатные ступени, потолок $0 для тестов с большими объёмами/повторами. Два конструктора: (1) single-model профили для простых LLM-вызовов бота/сервисов (service, conversations — как есть), (2) сборка из четырёх лестниц (build/plan/explore/general) для запусков opencode в агенте — три готовых профиля: free_100percent, master, advanced.
